compliance.emc: FCC 47 CFR Part 15 Class A, EN 55022 Class A, ICES-003, VCCI Class A
compliance.nebs: Not NEBS certified (datasheet compliance section: all models except EX4200-24P and EX4200-48P)

environmental.acoustic-noise: 54.0 dBA with the 930 W AC supply (datasheet, ISO 7779 at 23 C)
environmental.altitude: up to 3049 m operating (10,000 ft); 4877 m non-operating
environmental.humidity: 10 to 85 percent noncondensing operating; 0 to 95 percent non-operating

features.poe: IEEE 802.3af on all 48 ports, 15.4 W each, up to 18.6 W with enhanced PoE
features.uplink-module: one slot; EX-UM-4SFP, EX-UM-2X4SFP, EX-UM-2X4SFP-M or EX-UM-2XFP (not part of the shipping configuration)
features.virtual-chassis: up to 10 members over the 128 Gbps backplane; two rear Virtual Chassis ports

management.lcd: 2 lines of 16 characters with Menu and Enter buttons
management.oob: RJ-45 management port on the rear, 100 Mbps full duplex, with link/activity and status lamps
management.usb: one USB port on the rear

performance.switching-capacity: 136 Gbps packet switching, 264 Gbps aggregate, 64-byte packets (datasheet)

physical.datasheet-dimensions: 17.41 x 1.72 x 16.43 in (44.21 x 4.32 x 41.73 cm) W x H x D, and 18.8 in deep with the 600 W or 930 W supply; the guide's Table 3 is used for the envelope
physical.depth-no-psu: 431.8 mm (17 in, 43.18 cm) with no supply, with the 320 W AC or with the 190 W DC supply (guide Table 3)
physical.weight: 18.2 lb (8.3 kg) with the 930 W AC supply (datasheet); 16-18 lb (7.2-8.2 kg) with one supply (guide Table 3)
physical.weight-chassis-parts: 320 W AC and 190 W DC supplies 2.5 lb (1.1 kg); 600 W and 930 W AC supplies 3.1 lb (1.4 kg) (guide Table 3)
physical.width-with-brackets: 482 mm (19 in, 48.2 cm) with the mounting brackets attached

power.psu-redundancy: one supply carries a fully loaded chassis; a second gives redundancy (datasheet)

configs.description: EX4200-48P as shipped - one 930 W AC power supply (EX-PWR-930-AC) in slot 0 with a cover panel over slot 1, the fan tray, and the uplink slot covered. Side-to-rear airflow. The datasheet also orders the Trade Agreements Act build EX4200-48P-TAA, the same hardware.
configs.name: ac

gaps.wanted: A straight-on photograph of the rear. The maker's image library returned 404 for every EX4200 address tried, so the rear is read off the low-resolution callout figure and the supply and fan art follows the isometric drawings.

A straight-on studio photograph of the front. The datasheet's photographs are perspective views from above, so the vertical positions carry a 4.5 percent foreshortening and every front position is estimated.
Where the two-hole protective earthing terminal sits on the side panel and its hole pitch.
The bracket positions of the front, centre and rear mounting and of the 2-in-recess brackets: no figure in the guide measures them, so no ear position or kit is listed.
A library component for an LCD display; the LCD panel is a decor rectangle until one exists.
The four EX-UM uplink modules and their ports, left for a later uplink-module slice; the bay takes only the cover panel here.
The fan tray's power draw: neither the guide nor the datasheet states it.

a `power-draw-max-w` on each module this chassis accepts, from the vendor's own per-card table - Cisco publishes one per ambient, most vendors publish none, and until they land a module total is a floor
one of `power-max-w`, `power-max-ac-w`, `power-max-dc-w` in `attrs.power` (profile `networking` - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml) - unlocks the About panel, and comparison against other devices
`physical-context` on 4 bays (front 1, rear 3); `physical-context` on port group rj45 - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays

airflow.note: Guide, Airflow Direction in the EX4200 Switch Chassis and Figure 16: the fan tray "provides side-to-rear chassis cooling"; the datasheet gives 20.3 cfm. The chassis airflow enumeration has no side-to-rear, so `side` is written, the nearest answer; there is no back-to-front build.

chassis.note: Guide Table 3: height 1.75 in (4.45 cm) = 44.45 mm; width 17.25 in (43.82 cm) = 438.2 mm, "19 in. (48.2 cm) with mounting brackets attached", so 438.2 is the body between the bracket flanges; depth 17 in (43.18 cm) with no supply, and 19.25 in (48.9 cm) with a 600 W or 930 W AC supply, which extends 2.25 in. This model ships with the 930 W supply (Table 1), so the modelled depth is 19.25 in = 489.0 mm; the bare chassis depth is in attrs. THE DATASHEET DISAGREES: it gives 17.41 x 1.72 x 16.43 in (44.21 x 4.32 x 41.73 cm) and 18.8 in (47.8 cm) with the 600 W or 930 W supply. The hardware guide is the newer and the more specific document, so the guide's figures are used; the datasheet's are in attrs. 1RU.

colour.note: The datasheet photograph shows a black face with a navy top strip: the strip reads #191f32 (median of 800 px) and the lower plate #504e57 where a highlight crosses it. The face is drawn #2b2f3d, between the two. Supply and fan faces are estimated; no photograph of the rear is held.

ears.note: NOT MODELLED. The packing list ships two mounting brackets and eight screws; the guide mounts the switch on two posts with those, on four posts with the separately orderable four-post rack-mount kit (datasheet EX-4PST-RMK), recessed 2 in from the front with that kit's 2-in-recess brackets, on a desk on rubber feet, or on a wall with the wall-mount kit (EX-WMK); the datasheet also lists EX-RMK. No figure dimensions the bracket positions, so no ear position is written and no rail kit is listed in chassis.kits.

front-ports.note: 48 jacks in two stacked rows, four blocks of six columns. The top-row cavities are centred at 15.8, 30.0, 43.9, 57.8, 71.7 and 85.5 mm in the first block and 104.0 in the second, and the first column of the third and fourth blocks at 191.7 and 279.3 mm, read at 2.04 to 2.07 px per mm with the face's left edge at 0. The pitch is the registry's 13.97 ganged-jack pitch; the blocks start 88.0 mm apart, so the gutter is 4.2 mm. Row centres read 16.8 and 31.6 mm down, a 14.8 step. The top row is the same part turned 180 so that its keyway is up. The last column ends at 356 mm and the plate is bare to the right-hand block.

front-right.note: Read off the datasheet photographs at 2.04 to 2.07 px per mm across and 1.95 px per mm up from the bottom edge: the raised right-hand module panel 362.5 to 438.2 mm; the LCD window 375.5 to 411.2 x 10.3 to 19.9 mm; the Menu button centre (420.7, 12.5) and the Enter button (420.7, 20.7), 6.1 mm across; the three chassis lamps at x 427.8, y 9.05, 12.85 and 16.75; a face screw each side at (366.5, 22.0) and (429.9, 22.0); the uplink slot 366.9 to 429.9 x 26.5 to 41.0 mm; the model plate 296.5 to 344.0 x 0.9 to 5.0 mm with "EX4200" centred at 304.5 and the PoE count at 334.3. The Juniper logo at the left of the top strip, 6.4 to 22.2 x 1.0 to 5.1 mm, is reserved as a logo zone and not drawn.

fru-bays.note: Two power supply bays and one fan tray bay. The cover panel the guide ships for an empty supply slot is seated in slot 1 as shipped and the supply in slot 0. Nothing is built into the chassis.

gate-1-front.note: The datasheet photograph of the 48-port PoE switches (page 6, bottom right) is a perspective view from above: its face spans 906 px across for the guide's 438.2 mm (2.07 px per mm) and is 4.5 percent shorter than orthographic down. Columns are read at the across scale and heights at the face's own scale counted up from the bottom edge. The 48T photograph (2.04 px per mm) reads the same columns within 0.2 mm, which is the second image the figures are checked against. The guide's own figure of the 48-port front (Figure 1, g020081) is 565 px wide in the PDF and gives counts and order only.

gate-1-rear.note: Guide Figure 4 (g020084, 609 x 252 px as embedded), shared by all the EX4200 models: the chassis outline is 557 px across for 438.2 mm (1.271 px per mm) and its face is 5 percent foreshortened vertically. Positions across are read at 1.271 px per mm and heights at 0.828 mm per px from the top edge of the face. It is a low resolution raster, so every rear position is good to about 2 mm.

interface-names.note: Not printed and not modelled. The guide's examples name the network ports ge-0/0/0 and up, the uplink module's ports ge-0/1/0 and up and the Virtual Chassis ports vcp-0 and vcp-1; they stay here and not in an interfaces block.

lamp-legends.note: drawing-vs-photo: guide Figures 5 and 9 print ALM, SYS and MST to the right of the three lamps. The photograph resolves a dark bar there and cannot resolve type 1.4 mm high at 2.04 px per mm (the 2.2 mm numerals resolve), so it neither confirms nor contradicts the drawing. The legends are drawn as the guide draws them, in the guide's order of naming.

lcd.note: The LCD panel shows two lines of 16 characters. It is drawn as the green window the photograph shows; no library component exists for a display, so it is a decor rectangle and not a part.

lifecycle.note: Searched on 2026-10-23. Juniper's own milestones page was not reachable; third-party trackers (eol.network, parkplacetechnologies.com, relutech.com, serviceexpress.com) give an end-of-life announcement of 2019-02-01 for the EX4200 family, last order 2019-06-30 and last day of support 2024-06-30; two of them give 2013 dates (announced 2013-01-02, end of sale 2013-06-30, end of support 2018-06-30) for the EX4200-24P and -48P bundles. The 2019 dates are written, from a tracker and not from the maker.

other-faces.note: No source draws the top, bottom or sides flat. Each carries an `empty` sentence.

poe-numerals.note: The datasheet's 48-PoE view prints every numeral in orange, all 48 ports being PoE, and its model plate reads "EX4200" in white and "48PoE" in orange.

port-lamps.note: Guide, Network Port LEDs in EX4200 Switches, Figure 11 and Tables 7 and 8: each port has a Link/Activity lamp (green) and a Status lamp whose meaning is chosen with the LCD Enter button (ADM, DPX, POE or SPD). The lamps are the jack housing's two corner windows (common/rj45-ganged-eth) and carry that component's default vocabulary; no source pairs the windows of the lower row.

port-numbering.note: The photograph prints the numbers in pairs above the top row of each column: 0 and 1 over the first column up to 46 and 47, the even number set higher and the odd lower and to its right. The even number belongs to the upper jack and the odd to the lower, so numbering runs down each column and then across. The numerals are 2.2 mm high, drawn at 2.2 mm type (estimated), and placed 2.2 mm either side of the column centre where the photograph reads 2.1 mm left (even) and 0.7 to 1.3 mm right (odd), because a mark within 2 mm of the centre of its jack reads to lint as a slip at centring. The guide's CLI names are not printed on the metal and are not modelled.

power.note: Guide Table 9: 930 W supply, 48 PoE ports, 740 W PoE budget, at up to 15.4 W a port (up to 18.6 W with enhanced PoE from Junos OS 11.1). The guide and the datasheet give no typical or maximum draw of the switch itself.

psu-seating.note: Guide, Power Supply in EX4200 Switches and Table 1: the 930 W AC supply (EX-PWR-930-AC) is this model's minimum, and "All EX4200 switches support EX-PWR2-930-AC and EX-PWR3-930-AC". The 320 W and 600 W supplies are below the minimum for 48 PoE ports (Table 9: 740 W budget on 930 W) and the DC supply gives no PoE, so none of them is accepted; the bays take the three 930 W supplies.

rear.note: Guide Figure 4, rear seen from behind with x = 0 at the left of the drawing: the fan tray plate 0.6 to 245.6 mm across and 2.7 to 26.9 mm down; below it VCP-0 at 18.9 to 55.1 x 29.6 to 37.9 and VCP-1 at 67.9 to 103.9, the USB port at 121.6 to 136.4, the temperature shutdown lamp centred at (145.3, 35.2), the management jack at 153.7 to 170.0, the console jack at 180.5 to 195.8 and the ESD point centred at (218.0, 36.2); power supply slot 1 from 249.8 and slot 0 from 340.5, each 90.0 mm wide and 41.5 mm high from 2.5 mm down. The figure labels the left supply "Power Supply 1" and the right "Power Supply 0". The small round screws between the ports are named by no callout and are not drawn.

rear-ground.note: The protective earthing terminal is on the SIDE PANEL (Figure 4's callout), a two-hole terminal; no figure gives its position, so the side faces carry an `empty` sentence and it is a gap.

rear-legends.note: Guide Figure 10 draws M, G, M, T stacked upright beside the management jack and VCP-0 and VCP-1 under the Virtual Chassis ports; the legend beside the console jack is too small to read. MGMT is drawn as the word turned to read top to bottom, the VCP legends as printed, and CON as an estimate of the unreadable one.

rear-temperature-lamp.note: Guide, Rear Panel of an EX4200 Switch: "Temperature shutdown LED". No colour is stated.

rear-vcp.note: Two Virtual Chassis ports, "68-pin connector" (guide, Virtual Chassis Ports Connector Pinout Information), joined with the Virtual Chassis cable that ships with the switch. No document names the connector; a part of the family (juniper/ex4200-vcp-port) is drawn from Figure 4's 36.2 x 8.3 mm opening.

sources.note: EX4200 Switch Hardware Guide, Juniper Networks, published 2022-01-16 (341 pages; PDF created 2022-01-16; Juniper keeps it in its EX Series documentation archive, https://www.juniper.net/documentation/en_US/release-independent/downloads/ex-series/ex-series-doc-archives.zip, member ex-series-doc-archives/ex4200.pdf): Table 1 (models), Table 3 (chassis size and weight), Figure 1 (48-port front panel drawing), Figure 4 (rear panel), Figures 5 to 14 (LCD panel, lamps and uplink modules), Figures 15 to 19 (fan tray, airflow and supplies), Tables 4 to 13 (lamps and power), Table 37 (packing list) and the installation procedures. EX4200 Ethernet Switch with Virtual Chassis Technology Datasheet (Juniper Networks, 13 pages, document 1000215-026-EN, Feb 2019; PDF created 2019-02-11, https://www.juniper.net/content/dam/www/assets/datasheets/us/en/switches/ex4200-ethernet-switch-with-vitual-chassis-technology.pdf): Table 1, specifications, per-model weights and noise, ordering information and the product photographs on page 6 (2175 x 811 px; the 48-port PoE view is captioned EX4200-48P/48PX). Juniper's image-library photographs (www.juniper.net/content/dam/www/assets/images/us/en/image-library/ex-series/<SKU>/<SKU>-front-high.jpg and -rear-high.jpg for each EX4200 model) were requested on 2026-10-23 and every address answered 404, so no studio photograph is held. No EX4200 quick start is in the archive zip. Terms of use: the guide, datasheet and photographs are Juniper's, published for customers; none is copied into the library, only transcribed facts and new drawings. The guide's figures are isometric drawings and the datasheet photographs are perspective views from above, so every position is a measurement of a projection and is estimated.

uplink-slot.note: One front-panel uplink module slot under a flip-up door; the packing list ships a cover panel (the blanking panel) preinstalled, and uplink modules "must be ordered separately". The slot is a bay that takes the cover here. THE MODULES ARE NOT MODELLED, by the task's rule: EX-UM-4SFP (4 SFP ports), EX-UM-2X4SFP (2 SFP+ ports, or 4 SFP in 1-gigabit mode), EX-UM-2X4SFP-M (the same with MACsec) and EX-UM-2XFP (2 XFP ports). The photographs show the slot with modules fitted.
